settings.label: Folder
settings.notice: Server folder: a folder under var/openimport, or an absolute path inside a folder allowed under Stores › Configuration › iranimij › OpenImport › Safety. SFTP/FTP: the remote folder, empty = where the login lands.

settings.label: File name pattern
settings.notice: * and ? as in a file browser, several patterns separated by commas. Empty = every file.

settings.label: Move processed files to
settings.notice: Subfolder of the source folder, used when "Source file after a successful run" is "Move". Empty = "processed".

settings.label: File name
settings.notice: Placeholders: {entity}, {profile}, {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {run}, {ext}. Empty = {entity}-{datetime}.{ext}

Sheet (Excel)
settings.notice: Name or position; empty = first sheet.

settings.label: Record path (JSON, XML)
settings.notice: JSON: data.items · XML: /catalog/product or //product. Empty = detect.

settings.label: Root element / key
settings.notice: XML: the root element (default "export"). JSON: wrap the rows in an object under this key (default: a plain array).

settings.label: Record element
settings.notice: Default "item".

option.item: Only orders not exported before by this profile
New orders and orders changed since their export

settings.label: Statuses
settings.notice: None chosen = every status. Hold Ctrl or ⌘ to choose several.

settings.label: Created from
settings.notice: A day in the time zone of Stores › Configuration › General › Locale. Empty = no limit.

settings.label: Created until
settings.notice: This day counts in full, in the time zone of Stores › Configuration › General › Locale. Empty = no limit.

settings.label: Behaviour
settings.notice: Replace and Delete above the safety limit wait for a typed confirmation.

settings.label: Errors allowed
settings.notice: How many rows may have errors before nothing is imported. With "Stop" the other rows are imported up to this number; with "Skip" it only matters when no row is left. 0 = no errors allowed.

settings.label: Pictures that cannot be read
settings.notice: Pictures given as web addresses are downloaded and kept, so later runs only ask whether they changed. Pictures given as file names are read from var/import/images.

option.name: error
option.item: Report the row as an error

option.name: skip
option.item: Import the row without the picture

settings.label: Skip unchanged rows
settings.notice: Rows that are exactly what the last successful run sent are skipped. Changes made in the admin since then are not noticed; run with "full" now and then if you edit records by hand.

settings.label: Safety limit
settings.notice: Empty = the limit in Stores › Configuration › iranimij › OpenImport.

option.name: include
option.item: Import only the rows that match

option.name: include_export
option.item: Export only the records that match

option.name: exclude_export
option.item: Leave out the records that match

settings.label: Schedule
settings.notice: Times are in the time zone of Stores › Configuration › General › Locale.

settings.label: Time
settings.notice: Hours and minutes, for example 05:30.

settings.label: Cron expression
settings.notice: minute hour day month weekday, for example 30 5 * * 1-6

settings.label: Schedule is on
settings.notice: New profiles start off: switch the schedule on after a dry run you are happy with.

settings.label: Send to
settings.notice: Comma-separated. Empty = the admin who created the profile.
